label: lem:compact_complement_unbounded
title: The complement of a compact set is unbounded
statement:
Let \(K \subset \C\) be compact. Then for every \(R > 0\), there exists
    \(b \in \C \setminus K\) such that \(|b| > R\).
proof:
A compact subset of \(\C\) is bounded. Choose \(b\) with norm larger than both
    \(R\) and a bound for \(K\).
notes: Signature: `lemma compact_complement_unbounded {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) : ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ b : ℂ, b ∉ K ∧ R < ‖b‖`. Uses `‖·‖` (norm) consistently throughout the file; `|b|` in the blueprint corresponds to `‖b‖` for `b : ℂ`. Quantifier is over all reals `R` (blueprint says `R > 0` but the statement is trivially true for `R ≤ 0` so the stronger form is convenient).
